PowerDNSCredential.title: PowerDNSCredential
PowerDNSCredential.x-credential-instructions: Supply an existing X-API-Key and a publicly reachable HTTPS API origin. The selected server ID must be present in the protected catalog with daemon_type authoritative. localhost is the documented server resource label, not the API host. This proves resource access, not a user or tenant identity. No key issuance, webserver enabling, trust changes or private network workaround.
